method.transport: packaged CLI -> daemon -> loopback WebGateway -> native Safari
method.authority: fresh isolated ControlStores seeded before the packaged browser scenario performed its automated mutations
method.interaction: macOS accessibility tree plus native keyboard and accessibility actions
method.launchCapability: independent one-time capability entered through native keyboard; value not retained
method.discardedAttempt: one earlier isolated run was discarded after programmatic address-field replacement did not complete session exchange; no assertion derives from that run
method.shutdownCheck: manual-review process interrupted after current-session logout; loopback listener refused a subsequent connection

excludedClaims: VoiceOver speech order, announcements, rotor navigation, or verbosity
native Safari cancel-run or independent peer-session invalidation
native Safari console, CSP, performance, or axe automation
human product, content, or comprehension approval
normal-user reproduction of the discarded programmatic address-field attempt
